subtitulo: The essentials stay available in airplane mode.

rotulos.avisoCotacao: Reference only. Check your card or bank rate before spending.

mesmaMoeda: Mexico uses the same currency you already carry, so there is nothing to convert.

emergencia.oQue: The single national emergency number: police, ambulance, fire or civil protection. Free, 24 hours, everywhere in Mexico.
National tourist assistance line, for help and information rather than an emergency.

saberUtil.texto: Restaurants and bars must show prices clearly, in national currency and with tax included, and must give you a receipt.
A tip is voluntary: it cannot be demanded, and it cannot be added to your bill without your consent — check the total before you pay.
An extra charge for paying by card is treated as an improper practice, not a normal fee.
At the airport, ask an identified staff member where the authorized transport is; for an app ride, look for the designated meeting point.
There is no single national transport system: ticket, card and validation change from city to city, so ask before you queue.
